wireRules.requestContentTypeAppliesTo: operations that declare a requestBody only
wireRules.omitUnsetOptionalFieldsDetail: An optional JSON body field or query parameter whose value was not supplied by the caller MUST be absent from the wire. It MUST NOT be serialised as null, as "", as [], as {}, or as the schema's documented default. A field that WAS supplied MUST be serialised with its real value, including boolean false and non-empty arrays.
wireRules.arrayQuerySerialisation: style=form, explode=true (repeat the key once per element)
wireRules.booleanSerialisation: JSON true/false in bodies; lowercase 'true'/'false' in query strings
wireRules.noBodyOnBodylessPost: A POST operation that declares no requestBody MUST be sent with an empty payload (Content-Length 0 / no bytes).

operations.clientMethod: void acquireToken(String username, String password, String authSource)
operations.clientMethodNotes: authSource == null means the caller did not supply it; the field must then be absent from the request body.

requestBody.note: The resource-query schema declares 24 optional properties. This contract exercises 'name' and 'resourceKind'; every other property must never appear on the wire.

operations.clientMethodNotes: A null or empty list means the caller did not supply that filter; the field must then be absent. page/pageSize are not exposed by this client and must never be sent.

fields.name: resource-query
fields.note: The JSON property name is literally the hyphenated string "resource-query". It is NOT "resourceQuery". alert-query has no top-level resourceId property; scoping an alert query to a resource is done through this nested object.

operations.clientMethod: String queryAlert(List<String> resourceIds, boolean activeOnly, List<String> criticalities)
operations.clientMethodNotes: activeOnly is a primitive and is therefore always supplied - send it even when it is false. A null or empty resourceIds means the nested "resource-query" object must be absent entirely. A null or empty criticalities means "alertCriticality" must be absent.
Each contributing symptom carries only symptomId / symptomDefinitionsIds. The human-readable message, statKey and timestamps live on the symptom objects returned by getSymptoms.

operations.clientMethod: String getSymptoms(List<String> resourceIds, Boolean activeOnly, Boolean includeAlarmInfo)
operations.clientMethodNotes: The Boolean parameters are boxed: null means unsupplied, so the parameter must be absent even though the spec documents a default. page/pageSize are not exposed by this client and must never be sent.
task-status carries description, taskState, statusMessage and errorMessages.
The spec declares no requestBody for this operation, so no payload may be sent. After it returns 200 the token is dead and every later authenticated call gets 401.

errors.401: Missing, malformed, unknown or already-released token.
errors.404: The mock serves only the seven operations above. Any other method/path pair is out of contract.
errors.415: A request body was sent without Content-Type: application/json.
errors.400: Structurally invalid request body or a missing required query parameter.
